notes.title: Playtest update: September 18
notes.notes:
- New Cliffside area with various quests and parts
- ...accessed via the guarded barrier in the back of BeachApproach
- Mutation minigame that lets you customize your parts
- You can wear the Salamander Don's hat now (more hats incoming)
- Made the Salamander Don slightly slower and weaker
- New boss battle music

notes.title: Playtest update: September 6
notes.notes:
Many changes, please give it a try and report any bugs found!
- Water effects like splashes, trails, etc
- Various sound effects added throughout scenes
- Steam SDK enabled so you can take screenshots and whatnot :)
- Replaced the ground attack indicator system with an update (known issue: indicators don't look great in dark areas)
- New mechanics: charge barrier, weight-activated button
- Added screen shakes to attacking / getting attacked / landing from a long fall
- Added invincibility frames to player to avoid getting insta-killed by overlapping hits
- Added multiple save slots to new / continue game process

notes.title: Playtest update: Aug 3
notes.notes: - Fixed potential soft lock on completing Grampa Shroom's compost quest

notes.title: Playtest update: Aug 2
notes.notes:
- Changed primary keyboard + mouse control scheme to use mouse look (check the Controls window to switch back to right click to turn)
- Added a Video Settings window for various settings, including cam rotation speed
- Rebalanced all enemy stats
- Significantly sped up all attacks
- Changed all part stats (now parts only have 1-2 bonuses per item)
- Added typewriter effect to dialogue
- Various bug fixes

notes.title: Playtest update: July 28
notes.notes: - Fixed black screen bug for all languages using , as the decimal symbol

notes.title: Playtest update: July 26
notes.notes:
- Added a Controls window for setting keybinds

- Guide paths for important locations in first area

- New quest and creatures in forest area

notes.notes:
